title: Career Counseling and Placement Center, AWKUM, Facilitates 103 Students for ISPR Summer Internship 2026
text:
The Career Counseling and Placement Center (CCPC)
at Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan has successfully facilitated the placement
of
103 students
in the

ISPR Summer Internship 2026

program.

The internship is being conducted from
July 29 to September 04, 2026
, at
Army Public School and College for Boys, Warsak
Road, Peshawar Cantt
. It provides students with valuable
practical exposure, professional skills, and a better understanding of
workplace culture and ethics.

This initiative reflects CCPC's commitment to
creating meaningful learning opportunities beyond the classroom by bridging the
gap between academic learning and professional practice. The participating
students, representing various academic disciplines at AWKUM, will benefit from
hands-on experience, mentorship, teamwork, communication, and leadership
development.

CCPC-Team makes every possible effort to promote
the Honorable Vice Chancellor Prof. Dr. Jamil Ahmad’s vision of bridging
university-industry linkages and expanding internship opportunities for
students. The Center remains committed to fostering partnerships with leading
public- and private-sector organizations to enhance students' career
development and employability.
